
living_standard_cruise_passenger = {
	triggered_pop_group_modifier = {
		potential = {
			NAND = {
				exists = owner
				owner = { has_deficit = consumer_goods }
			}
		}
		pop_happiness = 0.2
	}

	pop_group_modifier = {
		pop_category_cruise_passenger_consumer_goods_upkeep_add = @living_standard_luxuries_very_high_passenger
		pop_cat_cruise_passenger_political_power = 14
		pop_cat_cruise_passenger_unemployment_political_power = 9
	}

	triggered_pop_group_modifier = {
		# Triggered to hide from the auto-generated tooltip
		potential = {
			always = yes
		}

	}

	potential = {
		has_nomads_dlc = yes
		exists = from
		from = {
			has_origin = origin_forever_cruise
			NOT = { has_valid_civic = civic_machine_servitor }
		}
		has_citizenship_type = {
			type = citizenship_cruise_passenger
			country = from
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 100
	}
}

living_standard_cruise_economy_passenger = {
	pop_group_modifier = {
		pop_category_cruise_passenger_consumer_goods_upkeep_add = @living_standard_luxuries_high_passenger
		pop_cat_cruise_passenger_political_power = 9
		pop_cat_cruise_passenger_unemployment_political_power = 9
	}

	potential = {
		has_nomads_dlc = yes
		exists = from
		from = {
			has_origin = origin_forever_cruise
			NOT = { has_valid_civic = civic_machine_servitor }
		}
		has_citizenship_type = {
			type = citizenship_cruise_passenger
			country = from
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 100
	}
}
